findings.detail: The first live projection implementation put the pending prompt into the history turn, so keep_recent_turns=1 could drop the previous completed exchange. Pending messages are now a separate projected layer.
Preview now reports the selected history budget and pending messages separately; the legacy max_context_chars budget is not silently reinterpreted as a full-payload byte limit.
When projection is enabled, request-snapshot or sidecar write failure stops before the provider send; legacy behavior remains for the default path.
Credential collision caused by short profile fixture names was isolated in test configuration; the request body check remains fail-closed on the complete snapshot record.

why: This is a medium Python behavior slice: opt-in layered projection is wired into Session with a metadata sidecar, preview shares the same selection function, and the legacy path remains the default.
not_doing: No real provider call, model summarization, memory v2 retrieval, live task-step projection, build/install, tag, Release or package-index action.
diff_walk: context_projection.py: adds canonical source/projection digests, copied messages/evidence, a separate pending-message layer, and the layered manifest.

session.py: routes opt-in profiles through the projector, bounds the projected messages by context_projection_max_bytes, writes trace metadata and an exclusive sidecar, and fails closed if evidence writing fails.
service.py: preview uses the same projector arguments and exposes preview_messages plus pending_messages.
config.py/cli.py: profile fields are additive and default off.
trace schema/formats/cli docs: document additive metadata and the sidecar contract.
tests: cover preview/request agreement, sidecar binding and failure, prompt preservation, schema defaults, profile writes, and legacy retry/fallback compatibility.
review_notes: Round one found the pending prompt collapsing into the history turn; it was fixed by a separate pending layer.
Round two re-read the changed projection/prompt path and confirmed the previous exchange survives keep_recent_turns=1 while preview and request match.
gaps: Real provider and cross-platform behavior, task-exec live projection, and measured token/quality benefit remain unverified.
